text: This staff report is about a matter that Community Council has delegated authority from City Council to make a final decision. Transportation Services is recommending that standing be prohibited at all times on the east side of Unity Road at its intersection with the public lane located north of Torbrick Road. The proposed amendment will deter parking near the lane and will improve sightlines for vehicles and pedestrians.
The Toronto and East York Community Council: 1. Prohibited standing at all times on the east side of Unity Road, between a point 25 metres north of Torbrick Road and a point 20 metres further north.
